column1: # The fixed journeys across the Netherlands, for `atlas-transit fixed <file> <this>` (tests/fixed.rs).
# name, from, to, date, time, what is asked (depart: the earliest arrival; arrive: the latest departure;
# window <minutes>: every best leaving>arriving pair), and the connection scan's answer. Tabs between.
# A place is a name (every stop called exactly that, with the rest of their stations) or lat,lon.
# The answers are of OVapi's feed of 16 November 2026; `atlas-transit fixed <file> <this> --write` writes them anew.
the last train: Amsterdam to Utrecht
past midnight: Rotterdam to Den Haag
before the first train: Groningen to Zwolle
Sunday morning: Maastricht to Den Helder
Saturday night: Eindhoven to Amsterdam by 02:00
the feed's last day: Utrecht to Groningen
Westerkerk to Amsterdam Zuid, two hours
the Vrijthof to the Grote Markt of Groningen
Texel: Oudeschild to Den Helder station
